description:
2000W Dual Motor Powerful Ebike: The 1000W brushless front motor and 1000W rear motor provide a combined 2000W punch, delivering exhilarating speeds of up to 31MPH.

Enhanced Lithium Battery Endurance: The SU7 retains the impressive 48V 22.4AH detachable lithium battery from its predecessor, ensuring a robust power source for extended rides. With a waterproof design, the battery remains durable in various weather conditions and boasts a quick 8-11 hour charging time, with up to 2000 charging cycles.

26-inch All-Terrain Dominance with Fat Tires: Sporting 26-inch, 4-inch wide puncture-resistant fat tires coupled with front suspension, the SU7 conquers diverse terrains, be it downtown streets, rocky paths, sandy beaches, snowy suburbs, or urban jungles. Versatility meets reliability in every ride.

Intelligent Ride Monitoring Smart LCD Display: The SU7 maintains a smart digital LCD display, providing real-time information on speed, distance, and remaining battery power. The 5-speed mode offers riders more options than standard modes, ensuring a personalized and informed riding experience.

Superior Performance in 3 Riding Modes: electric only mode (40-50km battery range); human-only mode; pedal assist mode (60-90km battery range); customize your ride with 3 riding modes and Shimano 7 speed Riding performance, you can enjoy riding in every mode. Perfect double disc brakes and lighting system fully protect your safety.

Full Suspension Electric Mountain Bike: The SU7 continues to prioritize rider comfort with a lockable aluminum front suspension fork offering 100mm of travel. Coupled with rear suspension, it effectively absorbs shocks, ensuring a comfortable ride on varying road surfaces.

Good Service& Warranty: With a 12 months warranty for ebike. 24 hours Quickly Response.

【UPGRADE】：Electric bike upgrades are based on buyers' feedback and experience! We have upgraded the headlights of electric bicycles and upgraded the color screen instruments!

Hidden Power, Enhanced Durability: The SU7 conceals its controller within the frame, fortifying it against rain and moisture, a notable upgrade from the V3.

Dual Motor Control Switch: An additional switch empowers riders to effortlessly control the front motor, seamlessly switching between dual and single motor modes for adaptability.

Sleek Aesthetics, Streamlined Wiring: The SU7 boasts a refined design with concealed wiring, elevating its aesthetic appeal and showcasing meticulous attention to detail.

Front Fork and Seat Enhancements: Upgrades to the front fork prevent wire entanglement, ensuring a smooth ride. The improved seat with enhanced elasticity and breathability maximizes comfort.
